Phoropter-tui is the first reader of these pages besides a browser, and it reads nothing else. Its brief to phoropter (../phoropter-tui/docs/for-phoropter.md) lists where it had to parse prose or lean on a class name to get something the page already shows. This plan closes the ones that need no decision about reasons, only markup and the profile. Everything it adds is additive: nothing a reader uses today is renamed or reshaped, since the rels and microdata are now a public API. The rest of the brief is on the shelf.

Decision: A view lists each match as an item, with its lines

where src/render.ts file page

quote <meta itemprop="matches" content="${v.matches}">

Because (phoropter-tui's brief): "where in this excerpt is the quote?" is answered today only by a <mark> and a note that says "quote at line 94" in prose: 28 views in mock-control, 74 in phoropter. Each match becomes a match item with startLine and endLine, one per match, since matches can be more than 1. The note stays, for people.

Decision: Each excerpt's first line is a property beside it

where src/render.ts file page

quote <pre itemprop="code" data-start="${h.start}">

Because (phoropter-tui's brief, then Claude, not asked): a reader numbering an excerpt's lines needs where it starts, and data-start and span.ln aren't in the profile. A codeStart property, just before each code it describes. Microdata keeps properties in document order, so the nth codeStart belongs to the nth code, and the profile says so.

Decline: Making each excerpt an item holding its own start and code

Because (Claude, not asked): it's the cleaner shape, but code would stop being a property of the view and of the place, and phoropter-tui reads it there. The paired property gets the same information out without moving anything a reader already uses.

Decision: The home list marks up its as-built and revisits links, and counts entries

where src/render.ts file page

quote const asBuilt = p.asBuilt ? `, with <a href="${rel(here, p.asBuilt.href)}">an as-built</a>` : '';

Because (phoropter-tui's brief): "which plans are done, and which revisit something?" shouldn't need opening each plan. The plan page already has rel="as-built" itemprop="asBuilt" and rel="revisits" itemprop="revisits"; the home list gets the same. "9 entries" gets entryCount, on plans and places both.

Decision: new has one shape

where src/render.ts file page

quote ${anchor.isNew ? ', <span itemprop="new">new</span>' : ''}

Because (phoropter-tui's brief): on an anchor it's <meta content="true">, on a place page's item it's the text "new". Both become the meta, with "new" still shown on the place page.

Decision: The profile says base and head can be text

where src/render.ts file page

quote return `<span itemprop="base">${esc(plan.beforeText || 'not given')}</span>`;

Because (phoropter-tui's brief, then Claude, not asked): gimlet's base is "none, a new repo", and the guide now says a squashed head: can stop being a commit. Both are written as they are. The profile says a base or head is a <data> with the full sha when it's a commit here, and the text as written otherwise.

Guess: Once phoropter-tui reads these, none of the closed gaps need prose or class names
